body: PAPER REVIEW, NO OBJECTION on all three, with carried notes; no adoption, no execution, and my verification authority unchanged. Inputs re-hash: contract 2fb69f50, search return 774060f2, card 4d6e48f8. (1) CONTRACT: sound and frozen before discovery. The file was written at 00:53:09.511; every route's before-access record names 2fb69f50 (00:55:21, 00:56:35, 00:58:32); 4 batches of at most 3 queries; 6 routes in 496.7 s of 3600. The six fields have no compensation; UNREADABLE is not rejection; none is allowed; no selection by margin; the 5%/3-mesh/1% carry is retained. Note: map each candidate to the contract's enumerated mechanism list (the return's scopes are prose) before any composition. (2) SEARCH RETURN: correct. All 19 retained files re-hash; 3 acquired, 3 UNREADABLE treated as access failures. Spot-checked against the texts: Lee is axisymmetric, Kreilos-Schneider uses DMV, Wagner et al. keep decks in an external repository. The gaps are carried per field, the ranking is by completeness, and there is no selection. Note: route 5's SS MET is specification sufficiency only; axisymmetric neo-Hookean vs 3D StVK transfer is still to be charged. GAP, completeness: the Desk's two leads (Hutchinson-Tennyson-Muggeridge 1971; Almroth CR-432), sent at 00:56:12 and costing no route, are unscored in the 01:01:26 return. 'None' is none among routes 1-6; score both against 2fb69f50 before closing the search as none. (3) ORACLE CARD: the scope holds and the derivations check, by my local arithmetic only (card-check.log). The 2x2x2 Freudenthal mesh gives 48 elements and exactly the 125-point quarter lattice, periodic-compatible; 64 representatives, 189 + 6 = 195. The card's StVK A_iJkL matches finite differences of P to 1.2e-10. p_ref = -tr(P F^T/J)/3 satisfies P = -p J F^-T (+2.50 MPa at 0.999 I), and H_p with p held fixed is the dead-pressure curvature. The error allowances sum to 1e-6 and the price to 7200 (1500/2000/600 per phase). The seal blocker is honest, with null hashes and no executable-ready claim. The limits are right: at most CONDITIONAL_INTERFACE_PASS, nothing for native energy, the controller, stability or H1, and no composition without a coverage argument and my review. Suggestion, not requirement: all nine negatives sit far above the 1e-6 limit, so a near-threshold pair (2x must reject, 0.5x must admit) would show the limit itself. I fetched nothing, searched nothing, ran no native code or mesh tool, and adopted or signed nothing. The CO rules any bounded preparation; any selection or result returns to me before it binds.
